title: "Create New" menu item in context menu for folders, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop now offers a Create New submenu that creates files and folders inside it.
explanation: Folder View only added the Create New submenu to the desktop background menu, always aimed at the desktop folder, so a folder icon's menu had no way to create items inside it. Open MR plasma-desktop !4210 sets the submenu's working directory to the selected folder when exactly one folder is selected (disabled when it isn't writable, hidden for files, multiple selections and the trash) and adds it at the top of the item menu. On top of the MR, new items are only given a desktop screen mapping and drop position when they are created in the desktop folder itself.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Add "Create New" to the folder icons context menu

Right-clicking a desktop folder gave no way to create items inside it,
unlike Dolphin. Show the Create New submenu aimed at that folder, and
only give new items a desktop position if they land on the desktop.

BUG: 451215

Create New submenu; Text File created Projects/Text File.txt inside the folder
